g.text: Spectrum is split into narrow frequency bands
Each user owns one band for the whole call
One carrier is shared by taking turns in time
Each user sends in its own repeating time slot
Users are synchronised by the base station
All users transmit together on the same band
Each signal is spread with a unique code
Receiver recovers its own user with that code
FDMA is simple but wastes spectrum
CDMA gives the best capacity and soft handoff
